plain: The act of committing a crime or wrong

webster.text: The act of committing a crime.

example.quote: It is true, the people, enraged at the enormity of his conduct, hanged him soon alter ; but of this the judicial power knew nothing until after its perpetration.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Gen. CHARLES COTESWORTH, January 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
